$comment: LitNode gauntlet config for this board game (node/gauntlet.js). For every match of the title a node hosts with this file, it spawns relay/server.mts for that match alone: the node mints the seat tickets, proxies wss://<wsAddr>/<room> to the process, and the process posts the ledger to the node's /ledger and exits. Copy this file, set cwd to your checkout of the game (pnpm install done at its root), then in the node's environment: GAUNTLETS=<your rulesetId>=<absolute path to your copy>, RULESETS=<checkout>/rulesets/<your rulesetId>.js, and RELAY_KEYS=<the public key scripts/relay-key.mjs prints> so a match the loser never signs still settles. BOARD_TC is the time control (<minutes>+<increment seconds>, or none); the rest are milliseconds. The GAUNTLET_* variables are set by the node per match.
